title: Hybrid-Segmentor: Hybrid approach for automated fine-grained crack segmentation in civil infrastructure
mechanism: Parallel CNN path for fine local features and transformer path for global crack pattern with a fused decoder, trained on a large merge of public crack datasets.
adaptation: Benchmark row with public crack weights; for our scores, init from their merged-data weights and add a 24-class head (or crack + inactive), gray to 3 channels, house loss and schedule.
min_experiment: Arm: Hybrid-Segmentor from their weights, fine-tuned; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill as a model if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.02; keep as benchmark row.
evidence: R: accuracy 0.971, precision 0.807, recall 0.756, F1 0.774, IoU 0.631 on their merged dataset; a third-party repo reports mIoU 67.10 vs UNet 67.39 on another dataset (web, unverified).

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark baseline with public crack weights: initialise from their CrackVision12K weights, gray to 3 channels, crack + inactive + background head or 24-class head, fine-tune on our folds.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: Hybrid-Segmentor fine-tuned; baseline PF crack channel; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU and relF1@2. Kill as a model if CV crack IoU < PF minus 0.02; keep as benchmark row.
